question: Which Indian cricketer is among those who will receive the Padma Shri in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ravichandran Ashwin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Padma Shri** is the fourth-highest civilian award in India, instituted in **1954**. It is awarded for distinguished contributions in various fields such as **arts, sports, literature, social work, public service, and science**.
 
• Indian cricketer **Ravichandran Ashwin** was honored with the **Padma Shri award in 2025** for his exceptional contribution to Indian cricket and his remarkable achievements on the international stage.
 
• **Ravichandran Ashwin** is a renowned Indian off-spinner and all-rounder who has been instrumental in winning several matches for India, especially in **Test cricket**. He is known for his outstanding bowling skills and strategic gameplay.
 
• As of **2025**, Ashwin holds records such as being one of the fastest bowlers to reach **400 Test wickets**, showcasing his consistency and dominance in the sport.
 
• His contribution to cricket has earned him recognition as one of the finest cricketers in the history of Indian cricket, leading to this prestigious award. </l
